basics.name: Alonso Caballero
basics.label: Front-End Web Developer | UX/UI Focused
basics.summary: I'm a Front-End Developer with over 10 years of experience building fast, optimized, and user-centered web experiences. I bridge the gap between design, business goals, and clean code — leveraging React, Vue, or Astro when scalability matters, and Webflow, WordPress, or Shopify when speed-to-market is the priority. I work with data, technical SEO, and A/B testing (VWO) to continuously improve what already exists, not just ship what's new.

work.name: Viajes el Corte Inglés México
work.summary: I develop and optimize digital experiences for high-traffic travel platforms. I build reusable components with React JS, vanilla JavaScript and Styled Components, focusing on performance, accessibility and maintainability. I collaborate with UX teams using Figma to translate designs into functional, user-centered interfaces.
highlights: Built reusable components from scratch with React JS and Styled Components.
Collaborated with UX/Figma teams in international environments to ensure visual consistency.
Continuously optimized the shopping experience with a focus on performance and testing.

work.name: GAIA Design
work.summary: I participated in the evolution of e-commerce from traditional Magento to a headless architecture. I developed and maintained promotional landing pages, optimized key funnel pages (home, listing, PDP, cart and checkout), and was part of the migration to a modern stack with React, Next.js, Tailwind and DatoCMS.
highlights: Migrated from Magento to headless architecture using React, Next.js, Vercel and TailwindCSS.
Optimized key funnel pages improving load times and reducing friction in the checkout flow.
Implemented A/B testing with VWO for continuous experimentation and conversion improvement.

work.name: Sales Ready Marketing / Inbox Marketing
work.summary: I designed and developed websites and landing pages in Webflow from design to publication, based on Figma and Adobe XD references. I implemented Zapier integrations, configured GA4 tracking and social media pixels. Responsible for responsive adaptation, interactions and performance optimization focused on conversion.
highlights: End-to-end development of websites and landing pages in Webflow from Figma/Adobe XD.
Integration of marketing tools: GA4, social media pixels and Zapier automations.
Performance and responsive experience optimization to improve conversion rates.

work.name: Interjet
work.summary: Front-End Developer on the UX team, building responsive interfaces with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and Bootstrap. I participated in e-marketing campaigns with Oracle Responsys and in continuous improvements to the site's header, footer and main sections. I developed the Disneyland ticket sales microsite and landing pages for the Canadian market.
highlights: Developed the Disneyland ticket sales microsite and landing pages for the Canadian market.
E-mail marketing campaigns with Oracle Responsys focused on conversion across different markets.
Continuous improvements to key site components increasing visual consistency and usability.

work.name: Liverpool
work.summary: I was part of the Front-End team at liverpool.com.mx, developing microsites and conversion-driven digital experiences. I participated in the migration to Oracle ATG Web Commerce, developed interactive HTML prototypes for the new checkout flow and collaborated with international teams on the launch of multisites for Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn and West Elm.
highlights: Migration to Oracle ATG Web Commerce and development of HTML prototypes for the new checkout.
Launch of international multisites: Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn and West Elm.
Development of landing pages for commercial campaigns and optimization of key site components.

work.name: CTIN (Telmex Technology & Innovation Center)
work.summary: Web development with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and jQuery, creating interactive and visually appealing websites. I delivered training workshops at Aldea Digital TELMEX, sharing technical knowledge and fostering digital skills in new talent.
highlights: Development of interactive websites with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and jQuery.
Delivered technical training workshops at Aldea Digital TELMEX.

work.name: Freelance
work.position: Frontend Web Developer · Webflow · WordPress · Shopify
work.summary: Freelance Frontend Developer specialized in high-performance websites. I build and optimize in Webflow, WordPress and Shopify, combining HTML5, CSS3 and modern frameworks like React, Vue and Astro. I manage projects end-to-end from concept to launch, applying WPO, technical SEO and UX best practices.
highlights: End-to-end development in Webflow, WordPress and Shopify for clients across different industries.
Applied WPO and technical SEO to improve site performance and search engine visibility.
Technical consulting and web implementation support for e-commerce and corporate websites.
